Alex Kim: Quick sync — PT1 postmortem action items need owners + due dates. Short list below from the doc; please claim and confirm ETA. We want cross-team verification finished by end of next week if possible.

Items:
1) infra: increase hot-retry backoff and validate no regressions
2) runtime: KV cache eviction fix + unit tests
3) deploy: safer rollback hook + smoke tests
4) security: review config change for KMS rotation
5) monitoring: dashboard + alert tuning

Please reply with the item number, owner, and due date.
